recorded: Every case passed against both originals: the JavaScript version with Node.js 26.12.1 and ollama 0.6.3, run as node trialforge-gateway-prototype.js, and the Python version with Python 3.15.2 and ollama 0.6.3, run as python3 trialforge_gateway_prototype.py. ollama-js 0.6.3 always calls http://127.0.0.1:11434 and ignores OLLAMA_HOST, so the copy that produced these cases builds its client as new Ollama({ host: process.env.OLLAMA_HOST }), a one-line change, while the Python client reads OLLAMA_HOST unchanged. The embeddings are recorded from nomic-embed-text twice, from the legacy /api/embeddings endpoint the JavaScript version calls and from /api/embed, which the Python version calls, and the replay answers either endpoint by the text, with input as a string or a one-item list. The two endpoints' vectors give the same similarities to within 4e-9, and every printed similarity stays at least 1e-4 from a rounding boundary, so both print the same. gemma4:e2b and gemma4:latest were not installed, so the answers are recorded with gemma4:12b-mlx standing in for both, and the missing model case keeps each endpoint's real 404, which both originals retry three times. The cases pipe s and n to the two approval gates and start from the audit trail the folder ships, or without one for the failure. Output is compared exactly in either original's wording, with the self-check function names free and the approval prompt followed by the echoed answer, as JavaScript prints it, or by the next line, as Python's input leaves it. On the failure, JavaScript writes [Erro não tratado] to standard error and Python to standard output. Requests are compared by structure: each index's clauses embedded once, tema and texto, in JavaScript's or Python's order, then each question once, and each streamed chat by its model, stream true, and both messages exactly. The trail is compared record by record in either original's spacing and time format, with the shipped lines unchanged and each similarity to three decimals, since the two versions' vectors and sums differ in the last digits.

cases.name: checks itself, indexes six clauses once, answers the routine question from the cheap model, the paraphrase from the semantic cache, the CSR synthesis from the expensive model behind the mandatory gate, which approves it, the off-topic question behind the low-confidence gate after three agentic iterations, which rejects it, and the minimum age at once from the protocol index, then appends to the shipped audit trail and verifies the last five decisions
